text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Today is our rest day from training, right?
So, Chan-Me will take her leave now.

No sooner had we returned to the academy
than Aston Machan went off somewhere.
I actually wanted to discuss our upcoming race rotation... but it can't be helped. It shouldn't be too late if we put it off until tomorrow.

While wandering around the school grounds for work
to get done whatever I could today—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer?
Aren't you in the middle of a livestream over there...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Did you not know about it, by any chance?
The presented smartphone showed Aston Machan hosting an emergency live broadcast on UmaTube.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So, what's this all of a sudden?
Calling me out like this out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to say goodbye.
To everyone, to Vodka, and to Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Chan gives up on the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And then, she pivots her career to sprinting.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: You seem surprised.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, it's not out of the question.
There's the issue of distance too...
But that's not what I mean—"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: After hyping it up that much!?
The Oka Sho was met with a storm of cheers. Everyone was eagerly anticipating what would come next, and—
choice_data_list: (And she worked so hard for it, too...)

text_block_list.text: She threw down the gauntlet, built up the strength to back it up, fired up the crowd with provocative words, and turned the Oka Sho into a spectacular stage.

All of this is to win the Oka Sho in even flashier fashion—
and claim the Triple Tiara with a brilliance etched into everyone's memory.

Can someone really back down
so easily?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Running it made me realize something.
It feels so far away.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "Perhaps this is just how it feels to Machan, though."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Still, as expected, both 2000m and 2400m
seem a bit too long for Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan has to stand out.
Because Mar-chan wants to become a mascot."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Since there isn't even any merch yet,
we want our next moves to be dependable.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: That's why Machan wants to go somewhere where she can be the sun instead of the moon.

A smile unchanged from usual.
Yet there was a familiar edge to the tone of her voice.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan is going to become
an Ultra Super Mascot."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Without fail. I swear it, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the important announcement
from Machan.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Marchan.

The livestream went dead silent.
The flowing comments were filled with sheer confusion.
However, the one who shattered that was—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So... cooool~~!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, what's with that!
Make it swift, make it sharp, and sayonara!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Charging down your own path, strictly for yourself...!
Ughhh! I wanna do something like that too!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "...Well, true. Being able to make that choice right away is one of your strengths, Chan-me."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'll miss you, but have a safe trip! Let's race again somewhere down the road!
Hearing their words, the flow of the comments began to shift as well.

"You got this!" "Do your best, Chan-chan!"
"The sprint division is stacked with tough rivals, after all."
"Can't wait to see you run, Chan-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe.
Yes, please leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Just beyond the summer,
the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
First, look forward to
seeing Machan there!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Chan-me.
Just curious, but your Trainer knows about this, right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: So you really didn't know after all.

Even up until now, she had rarely ever consulted me.
So this decision doesn't feel out of place at this point. However—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
About Aston Machan... Well,
I know you understand her much better than I do, Trainer,
but even so...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
She does have a tendency
to live life a little too fast, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"I don't think they kept it from you
out of malice, surely."
I have no intention of doubting you. Rather, the fault lies with me for failing to make you feel you could consult me about it.
choice_data_list: I will strive to become a trainer you can rely on

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
You seem quite positive about it.
That's a relief.

—And so,
next up is the Sprinters Stakes.
I hope the day will come when she no longer leaves me behind.
